Name: PHANTOM_PARAM_ST
Description: Phantom (ghost) look of a character: colours, rim glow and transparency of the phantom shader on its materials. A character's row is, in order: a scripted override, the SpEffectVfxParam Phantom Param Overwrite of an active effect, NpcParam Wander Ghost Phantom ID (one character type), then the RoleParam Phantom Param ID of its role (summons, invaders, ghosts). EnemyCommonParam's time-activated phantom ID and NetworkParam's bonfire replay IDs also point here. -1 or a missing row: no phantom look.

Fields.Name: Edge Color: Alpha
Fields.Description: Fourth component of the edge (rim) colour, sent to the phantom shader as is with Edge Color R/G/B. Retail 0-1.

Fields.Name: Front Color: Alpha
Fields.Description: Fourth component of the front (facing) colour, sent to the phantom shader as is with Front Color R/G/B. Retail 0-2.

Fields.Name: Diffuse Color: Alpha
Fields.Description: Fourth component of the diffuse multiplier colour, sent to the phantom shader as is. Retail 0-3, default 1.

Fields.Name: Specular Color: Alpha
Fields.Description: Fourth component of the specular multiplier colour, sent to the phantom shader as is. Retail 0 or 1.

Fields.Name: Light Color: Alpha
Fields.Description: Fourth component of the light colour, sent to the phantom shader as is. Retail mostly 0.

Fields.Name: Overall Alpha
Fields.Description: Overall opacity of the phantom, sent to the shader. 1: opaque, 0: invisible. Retail 0-1.

Fields.Name: Blend Rate
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game (retail always 1).

Fields.Name: Blend Type
Fields.Description: Blend mode of the phantom shader, 0-3. Other values aren't handled (retail row 290 uses 4).

Fields.Name: Perform Edge Color Subtraction
Fields.Description: If set, the shader subtracts the edge colour instead of adding it. Retail: row 290 only.

Fields.Name: Perform Front Color Subtraction
Fields.Description: If set, the shader subtracts the front colour instead of adding it.

Fields.Name: Is 1 Pass Only
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game (retail always 0).

Fields.Name: Edge Power
Fields.Description: Edge (rim) power sent to the phantom shader, which shapes the rim glow. Retail 0.1-8, default 1.

Fields.Name: Glow Strength
Fields.Description: Glow strength sent to the phantom shader. 0: no glow. Retail 0-10.
